scope: Republish KeyPackages when the relays hold none of ours although the local store has some.
files_to_modify: app/src/context/MarmotContext.tsx (the background KeyPackage task, after the stale-KP cleanup; not delaying readiness)
app/tests/unit/keyPackages.test.ts or a new test file

behavior.startup: Local count 0 → publish as before (awaited). In the background task, after the stale-KP cleanup, fetch own kind 443/30443 from the effective relays and count only events a local KeyPackage backs; a complete fetch with none → publish one last-resort KeyPackage again (the device has one addressable slot).
behavior.offline: A timed-out or failed fetch never republishes.
behavior.privacy: Only own public KeyPackages are fetched/published; no profile data.

tests: Unit: ensureKeyPackagesOnRelays decision table; countBackedKeyPackageEvents; source scan of the wiring and its ordering after the cleanup
non_goals: marmot-ts recording unaccepted publishes as published (upstream)
